reference.adaptation: Text-stop gate studied and independently adapted within V2 four layers: the candidate answer is kept as an interim assistant row plus a user-role nudge and the turn continues for a bounded number of attempts, then finishes with the candidate. V2 has no workspace verification ledger, so the evidence source is the persisted per-action receipt verification (actions.result.verification) instead of changed-path/workspace status; model final text and todo checkboxes are never success evidence. Default OFF (opt-in) like the reference. No third-party source copied, no remote fetch or real account/model used
